title: ai.auto_triage_initiated
description: Emitted when a Medic-role bot picks up an auto-triage mission for a DYING squadmate OR when an M16 affliction threshold (bleed_stack >= 3, compound TTD < 12s, etc.) crosses for an ally. Spec § Auto-triage Gherkin + M16 § Auto-triage trigger contract. reach_seconds=6.0; apply_seconds=8.0.

trigger_reason.description: M16 § Auto-triage trigger contract. Identifies which threshold crossed (bleeding_stack_3, single_arterial_wound, burning_at_low_hp, poison_stack_at_low_hp, continuous_shock, frozen_at_low_hp, drowning_with_helmet_breach, radiation_dose_high, compound_ttd_low). Optional; legacy dispatches that fire on DYING transition leave this absent.
